new_lessons.L22: docker compose up -d 是 no-op for bind-mount + static-image services. 修改 source code → git pull 改 disk → tsc 重 build/ → `docker compose up -d` 显示 'Already up to date' → wrapper 进程跑 OLD code despite disk updates. 根因: `docker compose up -d` 只在 image 变化或 service config 变化时 recreate 容器; bind-mount + 基础镜像 (无 pinned GHCR tag) = 无 recreate trigger. 修法: webhook handler Step 5 显式 `docker restart <container>`, 利用 edge deploy 必经的 webhook 流程自动 reload in-memory JS. 应用: 任何用 bind-mount + 基础镜像的服务, deploy workflow 必须显式 container restart, 不依赖 docker compose up -d 自动 reload.
new_lessons.L23: restart: unless-stopped + exitCode=0 daemon = infinite restart loop. 症状: harness-kernel 17h ~1610 cycles @ ~38s/cycle, exitCode=0 clean exit (类似 v1.2.0e.1 L7 timer.unref() 紧急模式). 根因: unless-stopped triggers immediate restart on ANY exit (clean or crash). daemon 设计上 clean-exit (e.g., python sys.exit(0) after main loop done) → 立即重启 → loop. 修法: on-failure:N cap 最大重试次数 → 多次失败后进入 stopped state → 需人工 `docker start` 才能再起. fail-safe design. 应用: 任何 daemon 设计上 clean-exit (kernel, batch job, one-shot runner) 必须用 on-failure:N 而非 unless-stopped. N=3 适合 critical kernel; N=5+ 适合 transient errors.

new_lessons.L28_NEW_warm_cache_conservative_failure: warmCache() crash recovery pattern: pre-existing non-terminal rows (pending/dispatched/running) are marked as failed/error='crash_recovery' on store construction. Conservative failure is correct behavior — we cannot prove completion status after restart. Phantom 'completed' state would silently lose data; phantom 'running' state would block new dispatches (no slot reclaimed). Caller can re-dispatch if needed. Pattern reusable for any state-machine persistence layer (queue_store, worker_pool, metrics).

Kernel queries via /api/orch/status when needed. Decoupling enables wrapper to ship changes without touching kernel (D3 lock preserved).
